endorsements.quote: For instance, in the case of deploying fully open-source LLMs, the responsibility for model custodianship, updates, and accountability for application outcomes lies with the deployer rather than the developer.

unlisted_practices: Global policymakers should collaborate with stakeholders across sectors to establish robust governance frameworks for medical AI that address technical, financial, and ethical barriers.
Health care institutions should deploy fully open-source LLMs locally to protect patient privacy and data security.
Health care institutions integrating open-source LLMs into health information systems should invest in dedicated staff training and infrastructure.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual/perspective paper analyzing the role of open-source LLMs in health equity through the health service triangle model framework, rather than an empirical evaluation or trial.
